_policy: NO mapping is proposed. AraCOVID19-MFH labels are multi-label social-media annotations; 'Contains_Fake_Information = No' does not mean 'supported by reliable evidence'. All 10 original label columns are preserved verbatim in dataset_samples.extra. The dataset is also text-less (tweet IDs only) and has no license file. A defensible mapping must be designed and approved by the research team before any entry is added here.
